risk: False cross-source entity merge
impact: Critical customer truth and policy targets become wrong
mitigation: Conservative rules, hard constraints, impact-weighted review, reversible split, precision gate

risk: Sensor or connector leaks restricted content or secrets
mitigation: Safe-fact boundary, local filtering, secret canaries, ingest quarantine, separate content protocol

risk: Accepted edge evidence is lost before central durability
mitigation: WAL durability contract, authenticated receipts, crash/offline certification
trigger: Sequence gap without explicit loss record

risk: Canonical database and projections diverge
mitigation: Transactional outbox, idempotent projectors, parity checks, namespace rebuild

risk: Coverage is mistaken for no activity
impact: False reassurance or false finding resolution
mitigation: Expected-population model, finding admission gates, evaluation-degraded state

risk: Gateway-derived metrics are presented as enterprise-wide despite bypass
mitigation: Eligible/routed denominator and visible caveat, integrate other sources

risk: Command executes on wrong or stale target
mitigation: Frozen target mapping, preconditions, signed capability binding, approval, effect verification
trigger: Identity version changed or precondition mismatch

risk: Policy rollout has excessive blast radius
mitigation: Simulation, observe-only, cohorts, limits, kill switches, rollback
trigger: Error budget burn or adverse effect rate

risk: Quilr 1 migration copies inconsistent identity into Quilr 2
mitigation: Import as evidence, re-resolve, semantic parity, tenant cohort rollback

risk: Live Quilr 1 scope is larger or different than repository analysis
mitigation: Production discovery inventory before cutover commitments
trigger: Unknown store, job, API consumer, or tenant behavior

risk: Shared cell noisy neighbor exhausts ingest/control capacity
mitigation: Per-tenant quotas, workload classes, capacity reserve, cell isolation
trigger: Saturation or throttling across tenant boundary

risk: Launch SLO/scale values are invented from development fixtures
mitigation: NEEDS_INPUT register, production-like measurement, accountable approval

risk: Source API/version drift silently changes semantics
mitigation: Version pinning, drift monitoring, reconciliation, certification, kill switch

risk: Support/operator access exposes customer evidence
mitigation: JIT purpose grants, field controls, audit, safe diagnostics, anomaly monitoring

risk: Restricted-content feature expands core scope prematurely
mitigation: Core works without content; separate gate and storage/access architecture
trigger: Core requirement begins depending on prompt/result bytes

risk: Identity resolution quality cannot be evaluated safely
mitigation: Adjudicated privacy-safe corpora, shadowing, customer corrections, synthetic edge cases

risk: Insight definitions generate unmanageable noise
impact: Low adoption and loss of trust
mitigation: Definition contract, precision gate, grouping, suppression, shadow rollout, feedback
trigger: Alert volume, false-positive, or unresolved aging exceeds bar

risk: Cell recovery replays commands or duplicates evidence incorrectly
mitigation: Idempotency, command reconciliation, edge replay tests, DR exercises

risk: Protocol breaks installed edge versions
mitigation: Compatibility policy, unknown handling, conformance, deprecation telemetry

risk: MCP tool names collide or schemas create excessive cardinality
impact: Wrong tool identity and platform overload
mitigation: Server-scoped identity, structural limits, schema digest/tokenization, profile quotas

risk: Cost estimates are treated as billed truth
mitigation: Separate estimate/billed values, price provenance, currency/time, attribution confidence

risk: Global control plane receives resident customer data
mitigation: Metadata-only contract, egress controls, data-flow tests, regional observability

risk: A compromised release is promoted across fleet
mitigation: Provenance, signatures, SBOM, staged cohorts, revocation, signing isolation

risk: Accountable roles remain unassigned shared responsibility
impact: Gaps at launch and incident time
mitigation: Named RACI and backups required at G0
trigger: Any tier-0 service or gate has no named owner

risk: Signing and CA private-key material verified in audited endpoint source may persist in built or customer artifacts
impact: Fleet compromise and invalid software trust
mitigation: Stop promotion; determine artifact/customer distribution; initiate incident response; revoke rotate and isolate signing; produce clean provenance-bound artifacts and customer upgrade
trigger: Any affected built/deployed artifact or inability to prove non-distribution

risk: Browser client and backend evidence are conflated or double counted
impact: Incorrect activity coverage and audit claims
mitigation: Separate profiles identities lineage and certification; stage-specific delivery semantics; reconciliation tests
trigger: Same native action appears as independent client and backend facts

risk: A multi-role connector gains unintended write authority or couples discovery failure to control
mitigation: Role-separated credentials scopes queues kill switches health and certification
trigger: Read worker invokes control or role isolation test fails

risk: Draft finding constants become unreviewed production policy
impact: Misleading severity noisy findings and customer distrust
mitigation: Versioned finding definitions; no universal defaults; quality and impact review; needs-input enforcement
trigger: Unapproved numeric window score weight TTL or suppression enters release

risk: Engineering tools create conflicting sources of truth or placeholder progress
impact: Architecture drift and false release confidence
mitigation: Tool-neutral authority map; linked traceability; freshness and ownership checks; immutable gate evidence
trigger: Ticket wiki dashboard or catalog conflicts with governing record
